component.name: L75 Config
component.summary: Configure the ROYALAXE × ProtoArc L75 keyboard
Configura el teclado ROYALAXE × ProtoArc L75

description.p: Unofficial, free configurator for the ROYALAXE × ProtoArc L75 keyboard over USB-C or Bluetooth: key remapping, Fn layer, macros, RGB lighting and side strip, per-key colours, the 240×135 screen (images and animated GIFs) and keyboard settings.

Configurador libre y no oficial del teclado ROYALAXE × ProtoArc L75 por USB-C o Bluetooth: reasignación de teclas, capa Fn, macros, iluminación RGB y tira lateral, colores por tecla, la pantalla de 240×135 (imágenes y GIF) y ajustes del teclado.
On Linux the udev rule from the project must be installed to access the keyboard without root.
New interface (dark and light theme), Fn layer with real system functions, packages for Windows, macOS and Linux.
